filter_findings.brokenRetention: not established; cohort retention unavailable, so no zero-churn assumption
filter_findings.noPathToProfit: not present for FoA; RL and frontier compute payback unresolved
filter_findings.evidenceSufficient: sufficient for Watch, insufficient for concentrated-growth sizing/action
filter_findings.riskDefined: thesis and cost-conversion monitoring defined; complete portfolio risk context absent

scale_anchor.interpretation: Historical trailing revenue used as a run-rate scale anchor at cutoff, not FY2025 revenue.

share_denominator_anchor.interpretation: Quarter weighted-average diluted shares, not point-date December shares.

net_diluted_share_growth_per_year.interpretation: Sensitivity convention for net dilution; future repurchase cost and award settlement taxes are not reconstructed.

capital_appreciation_hurdle.interpretation: Comparison hurdle; not calibrated investor requirement and not a total-return forecast.

assumptions.terminal_multiple_basis: Price / company_FCF_per_diluted_share proxy; not P/E and not enterprise-value/FCFF
assumptions.dividends: excluded from annualized price-only scenario returns; not asserted zero
assumptions.sbc_treatment: Company CFO contains SBC add-back. Net diluted-share growth is the scenario treatment; no second SBC cash deduction. It does not demonstrate that buyback/settlement cash costs are fully covered.
assumptions.annual_cashflow_paths: not modeled; terminal cash margins are conditions, not a claim that capex falls immediately in 2026
